adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the diff adds `contents << ... I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: "#{url}") ...` where `url` is only checked with `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` (prefix-only). That permits single quotes and other characters, so a malicious `url` like `http://example.com' onclick='...` can break out of the `href` attribute and inject HTML/JS. This is especially risky because imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and later rendered with `raw post.cooked` in `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, so the injected markup would be served directly. Escaping/sanitizing the URL or building the anchor via a safe HTML builder would be needed.
